captions: Tabelle 10.25 Lüftungsanlage komplett, Sachbilanz für ecoinvent
reason: Tabelle 10.25 (p.98) 'Lüftungsanlage komplett, Sachbilanz für ecoinvent' is the life-cycle inventory of the complete dwelling ventilation system as delivered to ecoinvent — the components, their renewal, the operating electricity, the transports and the disposal that this 'Ventilation of dwellings, decentralized, 6 x 120 m3/h, PE ducts' dataset lists per m2a. Tabelle 5.7/5.8 (p.37, p.39) are the same system summarised in the main text, and Tabelle 10.26-10.32 are impact results, not inventory.
